input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no post-termination transition assistance or data-return obligation on Licensor. Article XXI (Effect of Termination) runs one way only: licenses terminate immediately and Licensee must ship all Licensor materials back within five days and certify compliance, with all Licensor rights surviving. Searches for "return", "data", "transition" and "terminat" surface no export, retrieval, migration or deletion-certification duty for Licensor, and the confidentiality article (p0124) likewise binds only Licensee. Because this is a hosted FX trading platform where our trade and account records reside on Licensor's systems, silence leaves us exposed to loss of our own data on exit (the walk-away outcome). Inserted a new Article XXI(c) tracking the playbook preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return of Licensee Data within 30 days, and deletion with written certification thereafter; the 90-day fallback is flagged in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert Licensor transition-assistance, data-return and deletion-certification obligations into Article XXI (Effect of Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to return Licensor property on termination and is silent on our own data and on exit support, so we have added a reciprocal obligation for Licensor to provide up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our trade and account data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and then delete it and certify deletion. If six months is unworkable, we can accept 90 days of transition assistance with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: (c) TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA. Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return or make available to Licensee, in a commonly used, machine-readable format, all trade records, account records, reports and other data of or relating to Licensee that are stored in, generated through or otherwise held in connection with the Licensed Technology ("Licensee Data"); and (iii) thereafter delete all Licensee Data from its systems and, upon Licensee's request, certify such deletion in writing to Licensee. Licensor shall not delete, withhold or condition access to Licensee Data prior to satisfying its obligations under this Section.
